name: J. B. Harmon
role: Candidate on the Billings County and Stockmen's tickets, 1886
bio: J. B. Harmon was named on both the Billings County ticket and the Stockmen's ticket in March 1886, listed alongside Fred Banan and John Creedon. In the April 1886 county election he received 119 votes.
